description: Implement the Stage aggregate root exposing StageCallableContract to consuming workflows. The Stage owns Step membership and Stage Composition, coordinates Step invocation, defines Stage-specific flow semantics, and produces StageResult[TStagePayload] (envelope + specialized payload). Stage registers StageErrorTypeDefinition instances via Pipeline-assigned registry and creates StageError occurrences. Stage Flow Result is independent of any StepExecutionResult.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage owns Step membership and Stage Composition
StageResult envelope separate from Stage outputs, flow result, domain outcome
Stage registers StageErrorTypeDefinition via Pipeline-assigned registry
Stage Flow Result independent of StepExecutionResult
Prefect State never substitutes for StageResult
definitionOfDone: Stage callable contract tests for acceptance/completion/exception
Architecture test: Core not permitted to import Prefect
testStrategy: Stage callable unit tests; StageResult persistence/retrieval tests; architecture boundary tests
